page: Microsoft Azure E48nds_v6 is an Endv6 family virtual machine configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel processor. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server includes 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is designated as Premium Storage capable. The Endv6 family is network-optimized, facilitating high-throughput networking capabilities. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a high memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:8 and substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, this virtual machine provides high resource density for memory-intensive and storage-heavy operations. It is designed for workloads such as large relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring significant memory capacity and fast local scratch storage without the need for hardware acceleration.
